title: R5 completion minted by the harness: builder reports per-criterion {id, status ∈ met|partial|blocked, evidence}; the checker writes Closes-Inbox only when every criterion re-verifies; `partial` is a first-class honest outcome routed to carryover without penalty
summary: Over-claim is a contributing cause in 4/9 recent FAILs (1604 Closes-Inbox on a one-fifth-met item; evidence paths resolving to no file in 1595/1597/1604). Evidence: Kalai et al. 2509.04664 (binary grading rewards guessing), Confident-and-Wrong 2603.25764 (100% submit / 44% resolve), Anthropic long-running harness (`passes` flipped only after testing).
root_cause: Closes-Inbox is asserted by the builder in prose; the harness verifies it only at audit (inboxmover/closesmarker.go line-anchored marker) and offers no rewarded 'partial' path, so guessing 'done' dominates.
fix: Schema-enforced completion report per criterion; deterministic checker re-runs the cited commands/tests on the committed tree; Closes-Inbox emitted by the checker; `partial` routes to carryover with the unmet criteria listed and no failure_count bump; a false `met` (checker disagrees) is an automatic FAIL with tier escalation.
acceptance: A build report claiming Closes-Inbox for an item whose acceptance[] is not fully re-verified never produces a Closes-Inbox marker in the ship commit.
A build reporting `partial` with unmet criteria ships the met slice and re-queues the remainder as a carryover item automatically.
Regression fixture from cycle 1604 (one-fifth met) yields `partial`, not FAIL.
